title: Website banane ka kharcha kitna aata hai? Seedha hisaab (2026)
metaTitle: Website Banane Ka Kharcha Kitna Hai?
description: Website banane ka kharcha samjhein: design, domain, hosting aur maintenance. SiteBlitz packages dekhein aur quote lene se pehle sahi sawaal poochhein.
author: SiteBlitz Studio

blocks.text: Teen developers se website ka quote maangiye, to teen alag prices mil sakte hain. Sirf pages ki ginti same hone se kaam bhi same nahi ho jaata. Kisi quote mein ready-made template hota hai; kisi mein aapke business ke hisaab se design, content ka kaam ya extra features shaamil hote hain. Sahi comparison ke liye price ke saath yeh bhi dekhiye ki usmein kya milega aur kya alag se charge hoga.
Ek naam, teen alag tarah ka kaam

Template-based website mein pehle se bana layout aapke content ke saath use hota hai. Custom design mein layout aur customer ka experience aapki zaroorat ke hisaab se tay hota hai. Booking, online payments ya doosre software ke saath integration ho, to development aur testing ka kaam bhi badhta hai.
Inmein se koi tareeka apne aap mein achha ya bura nahi hai. Zaroori yeh hai ki jo kaam aapko chahiye, wahi quote mein saaf likha ho.
Website ke kharche ko in paanch hisson mein samjhein
Har project mein inka scope alag ho sakta hai. Kuch cheezein package mein shaamil hoti hain, aur kuch ka charge alag hota hai.

items: Design: layout, fonts, colours aur mobile par website kaise dikhegi. Poochhiye ki ready-made template use hoga ya aapke liye naya layout banega.
Development: pages aur features banana, mobile par check karna, aur technical problems theek karna. Kaunse features shaamil hain, yeh likhit mein lijiye.
Content: text, photos aur business details. Saaf karein ki content aap denge, developer arrange karega, ya uska alag charge hoga.
Domain aur hosting: domain aapki website ka address hai; hosting par website ki files chalti hain. Pehle saal ke saath renewal ka kharcha bhi poochhiye.
Maintenance: launch ke baad updates, changes aur technical support. Backups ya doosri services shaamil hain ya nahi, yeh bhi confirm karein.

blocks.text: Kam price ka matlab zaroori nahi ki kaam kharaab hoga. Lekin jo cheezein quote mein shaamil nahi hain, unka kharcha ya zimmedari baad mein aapko uthani pad sakti hai.
Kam budget mein bhi yeh checks zaroor karein

items: Phone par text, menu aur contact buttons aasani se use ho rahe hain ya nahi.
Photos ka size website ke liye theek kiya gaya hai ya phone se seedha upload kar diya gaya hai.
Website ka main content search engines ke liye accessible hai ya nahi.
Domain, hosting aur zaroori accounts ka access kiske paas rahega.
Theme ya tools ki licence aur renewal conditions kya hain.
Launch ke baad problem aaye to kaun dekhega, aur uska charge kya hoga.

blocks.text: Bada quote ho to har extra kaam ka reason poochhiye

Workshops, custom design, CMS, animations aur monthly support useful ho sakte hain, lekin har project ko sabki zaroorat nahi hoti. Vendor se poochhiye: is cheez se mere customer ya meri team ka kaunsa kaam aasaan hoga? Kya iska simpler option hai? Isse launch aur baad ke kharche par kya farq padega? Sirf bada quote dekhkar use galat na maanein. Pehle samjhein ki extra price kis kaam ke liye hai.
Website ke quotes tabhi compare karein jab unmein shaamil kaam, recurring charges aur handover ki shartein bhi compare kar li hon.
SiteBlitz ke packages aur unka scope

items: Launch package ₹7,999 ka hai: ek responsive page, ready-to-build hone ke baad 2 working days ki delivery timeline.
Business package ₹17,999 ka hai: pehle se tay kiye gaye teen pages, ready-to-build hone ke baad 7 working days ki delivery timeline.

Online store, booking ya package se bahar ke kaam ka written quote diya jaata hai. Domain aur hosting ke charges alag hain aur payment se pehle quote mein bataye jaate hain. Maintenance optional hai aur uska quote alag milta hai.

blocks.text: Ready-to-build ka matlab hai ki pages aur features likhit mein tay ho gaye hain, zaroori content, photos aur business details mil gayi hain, required access mil gaya hai aur pehla payment ho gaya hai. Delivery ka time isi stage se count hota hai.

Custom web app, bahut saare pages ya inventory software ke saath integration chahiye, to pehle requirements ka review aur alag scope zaroori hoga. Sirf in package prices se aise project ka budget tay nahi kiya ja sakta.
Quote lene se pehle yeh 6 sawaal poochhiye

items: Domain aur zaroori accounts ka control kiske paas rahega? Mere paas kya access hoga? Custom code, theme aur third-party tools ke use aur transfer ki shartein kya hain?
Website ko phone aur search engines ke liye kaise check karenge? Kaunse technical checks shaamil hain, aur launch par kya verify kiya jaayega?
Doosre saal ka kharcha kya hoga? Domain, hosting, paid tools aur maintenance ke recurring charges alag-alag likhwa lijiye.
Saath kaam band hua to handover kaise hoga? Kaunsi files, accounts aur documentation milegi? Koi transfer charge ya platform limitation hai?
Kitne revision rounds milenge? Ek revision round mein kya shaamil hai, aur kis change ke liye extra quote lagega?
Kya Google ranking ki guarantee di ja rahi hai? Number-one ranking ki guarantee ko warning sign samjhein. Vendor se uske kaam aur measurement ka tareeka poochhein, guaranteed position nahi.

blocks.text: Achha quote sirf total price nahi batata. Usmein scope, recurring charges, delivery conditions aur handover ki shartein bhi saaf hoti hain.

keyTakeaways: Ek hi pages ki ginti par alag quotes isliye milte hain kyunki unmein shaamil kaam alag hota hai: template, custom design, content ka kaam ya extra features.
Kharche ko paanch hisson mein dekhiye: design, development, content, domain-hosting aur maintenance. Jo quote mein nahi hai, uska kharcha ya zimmedari baad mein aapki ho sakti hai.
Quotes compare karte waqt scope, recurring charges, delivery conditions aur handover ki shartein bhi compare kijiye, sirf total price nahi.

faq.q: Kya ₹3,000 wali website kabhi theek ho sakti hai?
faq.a: Haan, simple requirements ke liye ek basic website kaafi ho sakti hai. ₹3,000 yahan sirf ek hypothetical example hai, SiteBlitz ka package nahi. Faisla sirf price par na karein: demo, mobile experience, scope, renewal charges aur handover ki shartein check karein.

faq.q: SiteBlitz kitna leta hai aur kya milta hai?
faq.a: Launch ₹7,999 ka one-page package hai aur Business ₹17,999 ka three-page package. Exact inclusions, delivery conditions aur revision terms Pricing page aur written quote mein dekhein. Online store, booking aur extra requirements ka quote alag milta hai.

faq.q: Website banne mein kitna time lagta hai?
faq.a: Launch ki delivery timeline ready-to-build hone ke baad 2 working days aur Business ki 7 working days hai. Ready-to-build ki conditions poori hone se pehle yeh time count nahi hota. Custom projects ka schedule written quote mein diya jaata hai.

SiteBlitz ke maujooda pricing terms ke mutabik, package fees par GST alag se add nahi kiya jaata. Domain, hosting aur doosri separately quoted services ke charges payment se pehle written quote mein confirm karein.
